caseNameFull: Solem, Warden, South Dakota State Penitentiary v. Helm

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 986.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that John Joseph Burnett, Esquire, of Rapid City, S. D., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
